newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 10 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed.
Inquiry was good, with demand moderate. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 80,400 cattle including 20,500 head or about 26 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Bids $61.00-$61.50 per cwt, with asking prices $62.00-$63.00, last sales Wednesday, July 9, at $61.00-$61.50.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - none.
